title: Maria Learns to Ride
text: Maria had fallen off her bike four times already, and her knees were scraped from the driveway gravel. Her older brother offered to just push her bike back to the garage for the day, but Maria shook her head and rolled the bike upright again. She checked that the pedals still turned, wiped her hands on her shorts, and climbed back on before the sting in her knees could change her mind. The fifth try wobbled just as badly as the first four, and she landed hard on the grass instead of the driveway this time. Maria stood up, brushed the grass off her shirt, and pushed the bike back to the top of the driveway without saying a word. On the sixth try, the wobbling finally smoothed out, and Maria pedaled the whole length of the driveway by herself. She turned around at the end, grinning, and pedaled straight back to show her brother.

how many tries it took before Maria rode the whole driveway
